scope: Seen development scenarios only; no statistical comparison or held-out claim. Failed physical criteria stay failed even when numerical replay audits pass.
audit_notes: Metrics audited for every robot. Reference decisions replayed for robot 0 only. Initial failed audits retained: 1e-12 bound tolerance was inconsistent with the 2e-6 runtime validator (observed ~1e-8 excess), and absent motion descriptors had been logged as null. Replay explicitly removes null descriptors in a copy; original logs remain unchanged.
